name: @amykit/plugin-linear
description: Linear as the tracker, over its GraphQL API.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when your tickets live in Linear. Over Linear's GraphQL API it mounts the tracker port ticket-to-qa reads its work from, and the read-only feature port feature-grooming uses. It needs a personal API key in LINEAR_API_KEY, and maps each team or label to the repository its tickets change.
